title: Visible-light-assisted degradation of crystal violet using CuO- and ZnO-incorporated (Am-co-BA)@PVA hydrogel nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13332-13346
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00342G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Iltaf Uddin, Tanzil ur Rahman, Muhammad Said, Ezzat Khan, Muhammad Ishaq
Degradation of crystal violet dye was carried out using CuO-/ZnO-incorporated (Am-co-BA)@PVA hydrogel nanocomposites under visible light. The hydrogels exhibited enhanced surface area, efficient charge separation and superior photocatalytic activity.
